mem.10:
2023-03-27: Andrew began Financial Analyst job 2023-03-20–26; no pets, loves eagles, recommends Fox Hollow. Family has dog. Audrey owned Pepper/Precious/Panda since ~2020-03; deeply attached. Photos: dogs/new collars on grass; birds against sun.
2023-04-02: Audrey adopted white female Pixie; adjusted after days, bonded Pepper; delayed hike. Andrew seeks dog-friendly city apartment near nature, small cuddly dog; trying Audrey’s sites.
2023-06: Audrey moved house; bigger yard, agility/toys. Uses positive reinforcement. Andrew enjoyed 2023-06-11 climbing; wants kayaking/bungee.
2023-07-03: Still no rental; Andrew cooking instead of hiking: rookie, creative stress relief. Audrey’s demanding training course improving dogs; all four age 3, two Jack Russell mixes/two Chihuahua mixes; love fetch/running. Playdate 2023-06-30. Favorite chicken pot pie: family recipe evokes grandma’s kitchen; promised recipe. Garlic go-to; Mediterranean roast chicken with garlic/lemon/herbs favorite comfort meal, recipe promised. Cooks with music/wine.

2023-09-06: Work stresses Andrew; coffee/walks help; hiked 09-02–03; Toby too young.
2023-09-24: Precious’s leash broke at park 09-22; Audrey caught her, soothed with hugs/calm voice/walk. Trains sit/stay/shake/roll over; walks multiple times daily. Andrew balcony flowers; Audrey garden/veg patch, easy-care Peruvian Lilies needing sun/water. Dogs love garden.
